answer_1.quote: we focus in this paper on the problem of AMR-to-text generation, i.e. transducing AMR graphs into text that conveys the information in the AMR structure.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we report BLEU scores, CHRF++.

answer_4.quote: We also perform significance tests by following. Results are statistically significant with p < 0.05.
answer_4.guideline: Two evaluation criteria are used: (i) meaning similarity: how close in meaning the generated text is to the gold sentence; (ii) readability: how well the generated sentence reads.
